subject: 4054 Mystic Valley Parkway Site Plan Review
overview: The Medford Community Development Board approved site plan review recommendations for a development at 4054 Mystic Valley Parkway and adopted updated board rules and regulations.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The board approved the meeting minutes from December 20, 2021.

items.title: Site Plan Review: 4054 Mystic Valley Parkway
items.summary: The board voted 5-1 to recommend approval of the site plan for a proposed lab building at 4054 Mystic Valley Parkway with conditions addressing environmental sustainability, flood mitigation, bike/EV infrastructure, and abutter coordination.

items.title: Board Rules and Regulations
items.summary: The board unanimously voted to adopt updated internal rules and regulations covering leadership positions, officer elections, and associate member procedures.

items.title: Miscellaneous and Updates
items.summary: Staff briefed the board on upcoming meeting agendas, pending zoning map change petitions, upcoming board vacancies, and future project filings.
